item.title: Version 0.20.1
item.description:
SupaSidebar 0.20.1

What’s New

  • Reset a Single Shortcut: A new per-shortcut reset button restores one shortcut to its default without clearing the rest.

Improvements

  • Background Tab Sync Always On: Switching to an already-open tab and background tab monitoring now run in every display mode.
  • Fewer Default Shortcuts on Fresh Installs: New installs no longer claim seven occasional global shortcuts that could clash with your other apps.
  • More of the App Translated: The Trash pane, sidebar tooltips, and color names now appear in your language across French and ten more languages.

Bug Fixes

  • Closing a single-tab Orion window no longer reopens the tab or leaves it stuck open.
  • Collapse and expand arrows now point the right way when the sidebar is docked on the right.
